Maya (sales): DeltaBank POC blocked. TS client on Windows can't stream, getting 407 through corp proxy. Any quick wins?
Devon (SE): 407 = proxy auth. Are they using a PAC file + NTLM? Windows can use WinHTTP which ignores env vars.
Maya (sales): IT says explicit proxy + negotiate/NTLM. They tested curl via CNTLM and it worked. SDK still 407.
Riley (support): Common issues: service process not inheriting HTTPS_PROXY, or CNTLM running as different user. If app runs as SYSTEM it won't see user creds.
Devon (SE): For streaming the connection must keep TCP auth. Try setting Connection: close on the streaming request or disable pooling for that call. Also check for TLS MITM; if the proxy terminates TLS you need to add their CA to the trust store.
Maya (sales): Can we give them a debug build?
Riley (support): We'll provide a build with flags: --proxy-mode=env|system and --disable-keepalive-for-proxy. Also share a checklist: netsh winhttp show proxy, pactester for PAC, confirm HTTPS_PROXY in service env.
ops-bot: CI: integration sdk-windows-proxy test failed in build 7910 - test_streaming_ntlm.
Maya (sales): Scheduling remote session with DeltaBank IT tomorrow 9am PT. Will paste logs afterwards. Thanks all :thumbsup:
